title: Cooking with attention
hookLine: Brother Lawrence disliked kitchen work, yet said he found God there as on his knees
tomorrow: should you sweep the floor for God, or just sweep the floor?

cards: Cooking videos make the kitchen look like a spa: slow knives, warm light, soft music. Here's a stranger kitchen. Brother Lawrence was a lay brother among the Carmelites, sent to work as a cook.
By his own account he had a great natural aversion to kitchen work.

And yet he said that in the noise and clatter of his kitchen, with several people asking him for different things at once, he possessed God as calmly as if he were on his knees before the Blessed Sacrament.
A man who disliked the kitchen, calling it as good as the altar. How?

teach.h: THE PRACTICE OF THE PRESENCE OF GOD.
teach.b: His answer had a plain name: the practice of the presence of God. He didn't wait for prayer time to pray.
He talked with God simply, while doing whatever was in front of him, and when his mind wandered, he came back without fuss.

teach.h: LOVE, NOT THE SIZE OF THE WORK.
teach.b: He said God looks not at the greatness of the work but at the love it's done with, so even little things count.
He would turn the cake frying in the pan for the love of God. That's the puzzle solved: he never had to like the kitchen.

teach.h: HE ONLY HAD TO NOT BE ALONE.
teach.b: He only had to not be alone in it. This is a Christian practice, born among Catholic Carmelites, and this path borrows it with its source named. Cooking with attention, for Brother Lawrence, wasn't a technique for calm.
It was company, and love, put into the smallest task.
The onion can be chopped for the love of God, as he would, or for the person who'll eat it. Either way the attention isn't on the clock. It's on the pan.

how: Christians who follow Brother Lawrence practice the presence of God through the day, talking with God simply while they work; people on this path borrow the attention and the love in small tasks.

o: a rule against talking while you prepare food
cooking recipes exactly by weight and timer
doing kitchen work slowly, with love, fully present

games.q: your roommate says she can't pray: her job is all noise and interruptions. what would Brother Lawrence say?
o: pray in the noise: do each small task for love, and come back without fuss when you drift.
find a quieter job; real prayer needs a still chapel and long, empty hours.
wait for a slower season of life; then there will be time to pray properly.
games.why: in his busy kitchen, with several people asking for things at once, Brother Lawrence said he possessed God as calmly as on his knees.

practice: If something to eat or drink is close by, take one slow bite or sip and stay with it all the way through: the smell, the warmth, the taste.
If not, walk through the last thing you cooked in your mind, the sound in the pan, the steam. When your mind runs ahead, come back to the pan without fuss, the way Brother Lawrence did.
